{{Quote|My father used to take me here as a girl. We hiked every inch of the park and bathed in the steam pools. After he died, this was the only place where I could find comfort.|Andra about her father|<ref name="TDoR" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Andra (Telos IV)|Andra]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. His child became the founder of the [[Preserve Our Wild Endangered Resources Party]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]]. When Andra was young, he used to take her to the [[Park of Sacred Pools]]. It made such an impression on her that when he [[Death/Legends|died]], Andra realized that it was the only place where she found comfort.<ref name="TDoR" />
